meta.name: web-design-guidelines
meta.description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".

copy.tagline: 检查UI代码是否符合Web设计规范
copy.tagline_en: Check UI code for web design guideline compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your web interface follows design best practices and accessibility standards.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 它会检查你的网页代码是否符合一套设计规范，然后按“文件名:行号”的格式列出问题。
howto.when: 当你要求它“审查我的UI”、“检查无障碍性”、“审计设计”、“审查UX”或“对照最佳实践检查我的网站”时触发。

say.text: 审查我的UI，检查这个HTML文件。
say.note: 它会读取文件并对照规范给出问题列表。

say.text: 检查无障碍性，看看我的页面有没有问题。
say.note: 它会重点检查无障碍相关规则。

howto.what_en: It checks your web code against a set of design guidelines and outputs issues in 'file:line' format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'review my UI', 'check accessibility', 'audit design', 'review UX', or 'check my site against best practices'.

say_en.text: Review my UI, check this HTML file.
say_en.note: It reads the file and lists issues per guidelines.

say_en.text: Check accessibility, see if my page has problems.
